intermediate.name: Valico delle Capannelle
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (S) Valico delle Capannelle (100.2 km)

story: Immediately after the start, eleven riders attacked and formed the early breakaway, later joined by Rochas. Otruba held on the longest but was caught at the foot of the final climb. Matteo Jorgenson set the pace on the climb with Wout van Aert on his wheel, reducing the front group to the main favourites. Christen and Vendrame managed to return to the front before several late attacks, but Mathieu van der Poel won the sprint convincingly.
